title: Source register of each move
statement: For a move site, define its source-register index in a register file indexed from $0$ to $17$ as follows: the source indices for copying $n$ to $a$, $T$ to $P$, $P$ to $w$, the selected endpoint to $SE$, $T$ to $SP$, $M$ to $V$, $V$ to $U$, $E$ to $V$, $SE$ to $E$, $T$ to $SE$, $V$ to $M$, $E$ to $V$, $E$ to $U$, $U$ to $M$, and $E$ to $U$ are, respectively, $0,4,3,10$ or $11$ (according to the Boolean choice), $4,12,11,16,14,4,11,16,16,10,16$.
hypotheses_covered: Register indices lie in the range 0 through 17
The Boolean parameter selects source index 10 when true and 11 when false for endpoint-stack push
